title: RAG-Fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion for Better Retrieval
description: A single query to a retriever captures one perspective of information need. RAG-Fusion generates multiple query variations using the LLM, retrieves documents for each, and uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion to merge the result sets into a single ranked list. Captures more facets of information need without changing the retriever.
authors: Shi, Min, Yasunaga, Seo, James, Lewis, Zettlemoyer, Yih (various)
